title: The Levite and His Concubine in Gibeah
description: A Levite retrieves his concubine from her father's house in Bethlehem. On the way home, they stay overnight in Gibeah of Benjamin, where an old man takes them in. During the night, worthless men from the city surround the house, and the Levite sends out his concubine. They rape and abuse her all night, and in the morning he finds her lifeless on the doorstep. He places her on a donkey, returns home, and cuts her into twelve pieces, which he sends to the tribes of Israel—a deed that shocks the entire nation.
